From: Rachel Barnes <rachel.barnes@redwood-assess.com>

Date: Tue, 28 May 2029 14:03:00 +0000
Subject: Request: emergency hotfix custody & CI evidence for SOC2 follow-up

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SOC2 reassessment for Acme Bank we need targeted evidence around a recent emergency hotfix you ran on 2029-04-29. Specifically we need:

- PR audit trail and branch protection settings that prevented direct pushes
- CI build logs for the hotfix job (timestamps, agent IDs, artifact hashes)
- Emergency change approval chain (who approved, timestamped record, any verbal escalation notes)
- Vault access audit for keys used during the hotfix (ephemeral creds, requestor name, TTL)
- Post-deploy verification (smoke tests, rollback criteria)

Can you provide these items or point us to a packaged artifact? If you can deliver a short mapping document that ties each artifact to SOC2 CC6/CC7 controls that would be ideal. Deadline for the intake is Friday EOD (2029-05-31).

Appreciate it — small subset of evidence only, we don't need full logs unless there's something that flagged.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Barnes
Senior Assessor, Redwood Assessments

Rachel —

Thanks for the clear list. We can assemble a concise package by Friday. Quick plan:

1) PR/branch protection: we will export PR timeline (SUP-2345) and the branch-protection rules snapshot.
2) CI build logs: sanitized job log for build job id build-0429 and artifact manifest; redactions only for temporary IPs.
3) Change approvals: DocuSign tie and a short chronology of approvals + on-call verbal note from rotation log.
4) Vault audit: export of the request entries for the two ephemeral tokens used (redacted key IDs).
5) Post-deploy checks: smoke test output and rollback window note.

I will package these into a single zip and include a 1-page mapping doc that references SOC2 control IDs. If anything in scope should be narrower/wider, let me know.

Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
